title: Priority in courts.
bodyText: All actions brought pursuant to this chapter or pursuant to the rules adopted under this chapter shall in the discretion of the court receive priority in the courts of the State.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: The amendment made by L 2014, c 218, §8 is not included in this section.

bodyHtml:
[§342D-20]  Priority in courts.  All actions brought pursuant to this chapter or pursuant to the rules adopted under this chapter shall in the discretion of the court receive priority in the courts of the State. [L 1989, c 212, pt of §2]

 

Note

 

  The amendment made by L 2014, c 218, §8 is not included in this section.
